attack.note: Samuro and his Mirror Images deal almost all damage with critical autos (every 4th or 3rd attack and Critical Strike). He has no real damaging ability apart from Bladestorm.

poke.note: No ranged damage. He uses Wind Walk and Image Transmission to close and he is revealed by his own attacks.

damage.note: Steady crit based auto damage multiplied by images (Illusion Master doubles their damage). Healing and Biotic Armor type effects blunt it, but Harsh Winds adds burst from stealth. His role in a draft is macro: split push, clear camps, tie up defenders. Measured siege per minute (about 7050) is the second highest in the league while hero damage is below average (about 1890) and he takes little damage (1841).

good_into.why: Mirror Images soak tower shots, Bladestorm clears a wave instantly, and Wind Walk heals him so he rarely has to return to base.
Great duelist after level 7 and strong at channeling objectives with stall, so he beats most heroes sent to stop him.
Image Transmission and Harsh Winds give burst on a lone ranged hero, and Wind Walk stealth approaches unseen.
Slowed or stunned targets take guaranteed crits with Merciless Strikes, and they cannot shake him.

bad_into.why: Stukov's Biotic Armor and Flailing Swipe or any sustain healer cut his auto damage and extend fights that his images cannot win.
Knockbacks (Lucio, E.T.C.) and targeted CC stop his autos, and he has no CC of his own.
Heroes that kill images easily (Jaina, Orphea, Cassia with Surge of Light) turn his decoys into free stacks and quests for them, and clone hitters like Medivh and Diablo benefit from them.

wants_from_team: A team that does not need peel from him
A healer that can heal from afar (Malfurion, Deckard)
Teammates who can fight 4v5 while he soaks
gives_team: Strong split push and backdoor pressure
Wave and camp clear with Bladestorm
weaknesses: Vulnerable if revealed or knocked back
Images can complete enemy quests and feed healing based talents
No crowd control and very low peel
evidence: Mirror Image, Critical Strike, Wind Walk, Image Transmission
Burning Blade, Harsh Winds, Merciless Strikes, Three Blade Style talents
Icy Veins guide: counters Stukov, Lucio, E.T.C., clone hitters
Measured: about 1892 hero damage, 7048 siege, 1841 damage taken per minute, 6.1 takedowns and 1.5 deaths per game, win rate 0.522 over 358 games
owner_notes: High skill ceiling. Offlanes well and later double soaks. Hard to kill, which is his strength: he pulls attention from objectives so the team can take them, and wastes the enemy's time if they send people to gank and he still escapes.

lens_notes.damage_delivery: Samuro and his Mirror Images deal their damage with critical basic attacks. Bladestorm is the only damaging ability.
lens_notes.target_style: Measured siege (about 7050 per minute) is second highest in the league while hero damage is below median, so structures first.
lens_notes.frontline_style: Offlaner in the draft sense, but he does not hold a line and takes little damage (1841 per minute measured).
lens_notes.durability_source: Wind Walk heals 2 percent per second, Mirror Images soak shots, and Image Transmission removes negative effects.
lens_notes.kill_pattern: Harsh Winds from Wind Walk and Image Transmission give picks, but takedowns are low (6.1 per game). Hunter reads his value as pulling attention and wasting enemy time, not kills.
lens_notes.escape: Wind Walk, Mirror Image and Image Transmission. Owner: hard to kill is his strength, and enemies who chase still do not get him. Deaths 1.5 per game is the lowest of my ten heroes.
lens_notes.utility_tool: Image Transmission and Mirror Image each remove most negative effects from him and his images.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Icy Veins: no crowd control as a bruiser. Slows only come from allies and Merciless Strikes wants them.
lens_notes.anti_cc: Two cleanses, but Icy Veins says he is vulnerable to knockbacks and peel.
lens_notes.camp_play: Icy Veins says Bladestorm and images clear camps quickly, but measured camps are 1.7 per game, the lowest of the ten, so teams do not use him that way in NGS.
lens_notes.objective_role: Good on point capture and channel objectives through stall and duels (Icy Veins). Siege measured very high.
lens_notes.power_curve: Weak early game, then beats almost every hero after level 7 per Icy Veins.
lens_notes.snowball: Rarely dies, so a deficit costs little and leads do not change his plan, steady.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Wind Storm build takes Bladestorm for waves, camps and finishing. Illusion Master is a passive style alternative.
lens_notes.team_needs: Icy Veins: fits comps that need an offlaner and do not need extra peel for him. Healing from range (Malfurion, Deckard) is a bonus.
lens_notes.vulnerable_to: Knockbacks (Lucio, E.T.C.), heroes that kill images (Jaina, Orphea), Biotic Armor from Stukov, and being revealed.

lens_gaps: vision_stealth cannot say 'vulnerable when revealed' (detection counters), and vulnerable_to has no detection value.
No value for knockback or displacement on vulnerable_to (Lucio, E.T.C.).
No lens for decoys and clones (images soak shots and also help enemies finish quests).
No lens for pulling attention and tying up defenders, which is his main macro job (owner).
